string.text: I have waited so long to hear those words... I accept. | Honored by {PLAYER}'s regard, I will share my life with you.
Between us... perhaps fate has not yet conspired. | This matter... allow me some time to think it over.
You do me great honor. I will serve {PLAYER} with all my strength. | Very well, my skills are yours to command.
I thank you for the offer, but I have other plans. | I must decline. I am not yet ready to bend the knee to anyone.
A wise bird chooses its branch. I will bring my men over with me. | This rotten old lord was best abandoned long ago.
Betraying my liege is not something I can do. | What do you take me for? Speak no more of it!
The war funds are already prepared for you. Take them. | For the greater good, this coin must be spent.
The treasury is strained. Let us revisit this another time. | That sum I cannot grant, I am afraid.
Good. From this day forth, you are one of mine. | I have been needing talent like {PLAYER}. Granted.
Your sincerity is not yet enough to win me over. | The time is not right. Let us speak of it another day.
All clear, sir! | Awaiting your command! | Nothing unusual in these parts.
{PLAYER}, it has been a while. | We meet again. What brings you here?
These are troubled times, friend. | Days like these... we just keep on living them.
What do you wish to learn? I know a thing or two. | I have heard a few rumors from the road.
Ha! You certainly know how to flatter. | You flatter me, though I must say it sounds pleasant.
Lord {PLAYER}, welcome! | {PLAYER} has arrived — everyone has been hoping to see you!
So you have come... | Fine weather today.
*hurries past with eyes lowered* | *pretends not to see you and quickly detours around*
Lord {PLAYER} graces us! What an honor! | My lord, whatever you need, just say the word!
...What do you want. | *eyes you up and down* ...Out with it.
I have already enlisted. Ask me no more. | I am already sworn into your service. No need to ask.
I am still young. Come back in a few years. | I am too young yet — ask again when I have grown!

A woman in the ranks brings trouble — but I will follow the old tale of the maiden who served in disguise. Please, captain, tell no one. | I will dress as a man; none will know the difference. Just keep my secret, captain.
A rogue named {TARGET} has been terrorizing the area. The bounty is {REWARD} denars — find him, and if you bring him back breathing, I will pay extra.
{TARGET} — heard the name? His head is worth {REWARD} denars. I am no charity, but he is cutting into my trade. Deal with him for me.
{TARGET} robbed me of everything I saved over a lifetime... {REWARD} denars is all I have left — help me get my goods back, I beg you.
I knew you were the right one. The man is delivered — {REWARD} denars, yours. Next time there is such work, I come to you first.
Good work, done and done. {REWARD} denars, the agreed sum. Well done.
At least there is a result now... Take the {REWARD}. Be quicker about it next time.
He got away? ...Very well, this matter ends here. Keep the deposit — go on, get out of here.
Ha! I knew you could do it. {REWARD} — as always, not a coin short. By the way, I hear there is a new hard case up north... interested?
Dependable as ever. {REWARD} denars — mind you keep them safe. With you around, these lands are far quieter.
Bandits have their eyes on {TARGET}! Every able fighter has left the village — only the old and the children remain... {REWARD} denars, help us hold the line — please.
I have been itching to teach those bandits a lesson, but I cannot hold alone. {REWARD} denars — stand with me to defend {TARGET}, and we will see that none of them go back!
{TARGET} is the village of our fathers and grandfathers... I cannot watch it burn to bare ash. {REWARD} denars — we all pooled what we had.
The village is saved... everyone says you saved {TARGET}. {REWARD} denars — it is all we could gather. Our savior.
The bandits have fled! {REWARD} denars, the agreed sum. The village is safe for now.
The village suffered after all... I know you did your best. But please, leave.
You have saved {TARGET} once again — the villagers scraped together this token of thanks, {REWARD} denars. Do not refuse it. You earned it.
I have a shipment bound for {LOCATION}, but the roads are not safe. Escort my caravan — get it there unharmed, and {REWARD} denars are yours.
If this shipment is lost, I am ruined. {REWARD} denars — and a bonus when we reach {LOCATION}. So, can you take the job?
The guards I hired before all ran off... The road to {LOCATION} truly is dangerous. {REWARD} denars. You look more reliable than they were.
The goods arrived untouched! {REWARD} denars, not a coin missing. Your skill as a guard — better than anyone I have ever hired.
We arrived safe, though the road gave me a few cold sweats. {REWARD} denars. My thanks for your work.
We made it in the end... lost two crates, but no lives. {REWARD} denars. I hope for better next time.
With you guarding, this was the steadiest journey yet. {REWARD} denars — I will call on you for the next shipment.
{LOCATION} is desperately short of {ITEM}! I cannot hold out much longer. Go to the market and buy me {COUNT} units of {ITEM} — the sooner the better! {REWARD} denars.
{ITEM} has run dry in {LOCATION} — if I cannot restock, my business is finished. A budget of {REWARD} denars — the less you spend, the more is yours to keep. Be quick!
Back already? The {ITEM} is just what was needed! {REWARD} denars — you work fast.
Finally, here it is. {REWARD} denars — my business can go on.
You could not get it? ...This is a problem. We will speak of the deposit another time — I must think of another way.
My {ITEM} was stolen! The thief was last seen heading toward {LOCATION}. Help me get it back — {REWARD} denars.
That is it! I thought I would never see it again... {REWARD} denars, as promised. Thank you.
Could not find it... Well, out with the old, in with the new. You did your best.
My friend {TARGET} is held in the prison at {LOCATION} — he is innocent. Help me free him, {REWARD} denars.
He is out! {TARGET} asked me to thank you — keep the {REWARD} denars. This debt of gratitude we will not forget.
There is a bandit lair near {LOCATION} — caravans dare not pass. Clear it out — {REWARD} denars, pooled by all the local merchants.
The lair is destroyed! The roads are finally safe. {REWARD} denars — the caravan masters asked me to pass on their regards.
I got my hands on a treasure map — the spot is near {LOCATION} — but I dare not go alone. Come with me: {REWARD} denars, and we split whatever we find.
We really found it! My judgment was right — {REWARD} denars is your share. When I get the next map, you are the one I will call!
Someone is hunting me, and they are close. Take a few men and draw them off — the longer you hold them, the bigger your reward. {REWARD} denars to start.
You got out unscathed! They chased the wrong trail — I am safe now. {REWARD} denars — take it. You saved my life.
I need a {ITEM}, but I cannot be seen buying it myself. Here are {REWARD} denars as your budget — shop the markets and compare prices; the less you spend, the more you keep.
Exactly what I wanted! You are swifter than every agent I have ever used. {REWARD} denars — a pleasure doing business.
I have arranged a special bout at the arena — no shields, pure skill. Fight it in my place: {REWARD} denars, doubled if you win.
You won it all! The crowd went mad! {REWARD} denars — I bet on the right man. I will call on you again!
{TARGET} — a bandit king who has terrorized these lands for years, carrying gear unlike any other. Defeat him: the equipment is yours, with a {REWARD} denar reward on top.
You truly defeated him... the merchants on this road can finally sleep soundly. {REWARD} denars — you are a true hunter.
{LOCATION} has run out of food! Here are {COUNT} units of {ITEM} — deliver them within {DAYS} days. The faster you are, the higher the pay, starting at {REWARD} denars.
Just in time! One day later and people would have starved. {REWARD} denars — you run faster than the wind.
I want a {ITEM}. Shop the horse markets of the great towns and compare — {REWARD} denars as budget, and whatever you save is yours.
A fine horse! I searched for half a year without finding one — where did you get it? {REWARD} denars, money well spent.
My fighter hurt his leg last night. Take my place in the underground ring at {LOCATION} — win, and we split the {REWARD} denar prize.
A knockout in one blow! You are ten times the fighter my man was. {REWARD} denars — when there is a next bout, you will be my first call.
The enemy is shipping a supply convoy to {LOCATION}. Intercept it before it arrives — {REWARD} denars for the job, and the supplies are yours to keep.
A clean interception! The enemy is cut off from supplies — their advance will stall for a while. {REWARD} denars — fine work.
{TARGET} — that is the name. {REWARD} denars. I am not afraid of him, but one man cannot fight a pack. Come at him with me — let them learn who rules this ground.
I have been watching {TARGET} for a while. He has many men, but there is a gap at every guard change. {REWARD} denars — strike at the right moment. Do not charge in blindly.
{TARGET} preys on the poorest villages in these parts. We pooled {REWARD} denars. I do not ask you to risk your life recklessly — but at least give the folk their vengeance.
Ha, that was satisfying! I knew calling you was the right move. {REWARD} denars — next hard case, we take it on together again!
This village is poor, but every household is made of honest folk. Bandits mean to burn their homes — {REWARD} denars. Whether you help is a matter for your conscience.
Plenty of goods, dangerous roads — just to your taste, eh? {REWARD} denars, and a drink on me when we reach {LOCATION}. This run will not be dull.
The folk of {LOCATION} live in dread day and night — a bandit gang has pitched camp just outside the village.
{NPC} has abducted {TARGET} — the family has begged for help for days. Time is running out.
The granaries of {LOCATION} are nearly empty. The old and the young have eaten wild greens for days.
{NPC} has betrayed {TARGET} — a blade from the one you trust most cuts deeper than any sword.
{NPC} is pressing {TARGET} over a debt — the creditor has set a final deadline, after which the deed to the land is forfeit.
{NPC} has stolen {LOCATION}'s heirloom relic — without it, the new chieftain cannot even convene the clan council.
{NPC} has assassinated {TARGET} in {LOCATION}. Now everyone fears for their life — who will be next?
Some say {NPC} bears a new scar on his face — they claim you gave it to him. He is looking for you.
Word of {NPC} beating you last time has spread through these parts. When do you plan to even the score?
Mention {NPC}... that name silences many a room. Your feud with him is no longer a secret.
Heard the news? Someone has already settled the trouble at {LOCATION}. That one knows their business.
{TARGET} has been falsely accused — the real culprit is still at large. The lord of {LOCATION} has ordered an arrest. Delay any longer and it will be too late!
The old chieftain of {LOCATION} has passed — the heirs are rallying their factions. {TARGET}'s claim to the succession hangs by a thread.
{NPC}'s hunters have reached the outskirts of {LOCATION} — {TARGET} is hiding here. Is he a fugitive or an innocent?
The market of {LOCATION} has descended into chaos — merchants are crushing one another, and {TARGET}'s trade is about to collapse.
{NPC} is mustering troops on the border of {LOCATION} — a clash with {TARGET} is about to erupt.
In {LOCATION}, hearts are tangled in trouble — {TARGET} is caught in a romance from which there is no easy escape. The honor of both families hangs in the balance.
Someone has come back — that scar still aches. He is looking for you, {TARGET}. And he has grown stronger.
I hear { LOCATION } is plagued by bandits... folk dare not leave their homes at night. What is the world coming to, eh...
Someone in {LOCATION} has been taken — the family is running about in a panic. The ransom the kidnappers demand is no small sum.
{LOCATION} is nearly out of grain... the old and the young have been chewing bark for days. This is no way to live.
A snake in the house at {LOCATION}. Stabbed by the one they trusted most — hurts worse than any knife.
Something terrible happened at {LOCATION} — {TARGET} has been murdered. Now the whole town fears for itself, everyone wondering who is next.
Have you heard? {LOCATION} was sacked by bandits... no one came to help, and half the village burned. A terrible thing.
Word from {LOCATION} — the one who was taken is dead. The ransom did not arrive in time... his family's weeping could be heard across the village.
Many have died in {LOCATION}. Starved. The grain never arrived.

{LOCATION} has lacked {ITEM} for quite some time — I have been to every nearby market myself and found none. {REWARD} denars — your connections are better than mine. Get me {COUNT} units of {ITEM}, and be quick about it!
I beg you — without {ITEM}, people will die in {LOCATION}. I have begged everyone, and no one answered... {REWARD} denars is everything I have. Please, get me {COUNT} units of {ITEM}...
Someone stole my {ITEM} in the chaos. I know who it is — he fled toward {LOCATION}. {REWARD} denars. Chase him down with me — I want to see what gave him the nerve to rob me.

That {ITEM} was my mother's gift to me... and it was stolen. I tracked the trail as far as {LOCATION} before it went cold. {REWARD} denars — it is not much, but if you can recover it, I will be grateful to you all my life.

Someone swiped my {ITEM} — the thing itself is worth little, but the buyer has already paid a deposit. Track it down at {LOCATION} for {REWARD} denars — and if you can rough up the thief along the way, I will add more.
{TARGET} is my brother — wrongly imprisoned at {LOCATION}. I have already learned the guards' shift patterns. {REWARD} denars — we strike tonight. You and I, in together.
{TARGET} cannot last much longer in there... they say he stole something, but it was a frame-up. {REWARD} denars — I beg you, free him at {LOCATION}. Delay, and it will be too late.
{TARGET} knows the location of a hidden treasure — but he is locked up at {LOCATION} right now. Get him out for me. Once he reveals the map, I will share your cut. Take {REWARD} denars up front.
I have had my eye on that lair at {LOCATION} for a long time — they always strike first. Not this time. {REWARD} denars — we hit them before they hit us and burn the nest!

No caravan from {LOCATION} has come through for a month — all because of that lair. If no one deals with it, our village's goods cannot go out and grain cannot come in... {REWARD} denars, pooled by the whole village. Please.

Those brigands at {LOCATION} have been taking more and more loot — which means their den is well stocked by now. Clear them out: {REWARD} denars is yours, and we split what we find in the lair fifty-fifty?
The treasure map is genuine — I had it verified. The site is at {LOCATION}, said to be guarded by traps. {REWARD} denars. Let us join forces — if you have the nerve, come with me!
This map cost me half my fortune... but I dare not go to {LOCATION} alone. {REWARD} denars — if we find the treasure, we split it. If not, I accept the loss. All I lack is a companion who can fight.

This map points to {LOCATION} — I have done the math, and by the markers on it, that haul is worth at least this much. {REWARD} denars is your fee for the trouble, with a heavy bonus when we find it. Partners?

The men hunting me number about twenty. I need you to take a few people, make a commotion at the crossroads, and draw them off. {REWARD} denars — hold them for half an hour, and I can slip away through the mountain path.
They are almost here — and I have no one else to turn to. Take your people west and draw the hunters off... I beg you. {REWARD} denars. If I live through this, I will owe you a lifetime of gratitude.

Someone has paid a fortune for my head. Draw off my pursuers — {REWARD} denars to start, and the longer you hold them, the more I add. Any veteran of this trade knows: the greater the risk, the greater the reward.

I need a {ITEM} — not ordinary stock. I have scouted prices at every major market, but some sellers will only deal with men of standing. {REWARD} denars as budget — you negotiate in my stead, and all you save is yours.
I must have that {ITEM} no matter what — but the seller swears he will not trade with my kind. {REWARD} denars — go in my place. You carry more weight than I do... please.
I have my eye on a {ITEM}, but the seller's price is outrageous. {REWARD} denars is your bargaining room — drive the price down, and the difference is yours. Generous, no?
A special bout at the arena — no shields, pure skill. I have wagered heavily on you. {REWARD} denars just to enter the ring, doubled if you win. Get in there and show them what real skill looks like!
I am drowning in debt — only the odds on this special bout can bail me out. But I cannot fight myself; my arm is hurt. {REWARD} denars — fight in my place. Win, and all is well. Lose... and so be it.
I have seen the matchup — your opponent is strong, but slow. {REWARD} denars to enter, and the odds on your victory are excellent. Win, and we split the winnings. What do you say?

{TARGET} — in these parts, that name is fear itself. But I have never believed in omens. {REWARD} denars in bounty, plus whatever he carries — they say he bears a one-of-a-kind blade. If you have the guts, come hunt him with me.

{TARGET} killed my brother. The authorities will do nothing — they call him a bandit king that no one dares touch. {REWARD} denars is every coin I have saved... Not for the money — for justice. Will you help me?

{TARGET} — three lords have posted bounties on his head. {REWARD} denars is just my share; collect the other two and you take home three times as much. A merchant spreads his holdings — this job feeds you for a year.

{LOCATION} is out of grain — and bandits are raiding supply convoys on the road. Here are {COUNT} units of {ITEM}; deliver them within {DAYS} days. {REWARD} denars — a sharp blade beats swift legs. If you meet road agents, cut straight through them!

The old and the young at {LOCATION} have been drinking thin gruel for four days — it was their last food. These {COUNT} units of {ITEM} are life-saving grain; if it does not arrive within {DAYS} days, people will truly starve. {REWARD} denars... I beg you.

{LOCATION}'s shortage means grain prices are about to rise. Here are {COUNT} units of {ITEM} — deliver within {DAYS} days for {REWARD} denars. Get it there early and I will sell before the prices climb, with a share of the profit for you.
I want a {ITEM} — not for riding, but for battle. Search the horse markets and pick the fiercest one. {REWARD} denars is your budget — do not skimp for me. I want the best!

My old horse died — she carried me for ten years. I have looked at several replacements, but they are all too old or too slow. Find me a {ITEM} — {REWARD} denars as budget. I trust your eye more than my own.

I have scouted the prices at every major horse market — there is a {ITEM} up north priced far too high. Go bargain it down for me. {REWARD} denars budget; the lower you drive it, half of what you save is yours.

The rules of the underground pit are simple — put the other man down. My fighter was hurt last night, but I already paid the entry fee and cannot withdraw. {REWARD} denars — fight in my place at {LOCATION}. Win, and we split the purse!
I wagered everything I own in the underground pit — and my fighter broke his leg. If I forfeit, I am ruined. {REWARD} denars — fight this bout for me at {LOCATION}. You are my last hope...

There is a main event at the underground pit in {LOCATION} tonight — my fighter cannot compete, but the odds are too good to pass up. {REWARD} denars for you to fight in my place; win, and the purse splits sixty-forty your way. Are you not tempted by those odds?

An enemy supply column is moving through the mountain passes toward {LOCATION} — light escort, but all veterans. {REWARD} denars! Cut off that convoy, and the enemy's advance stalls for a fortnight. In or out?

If those supplies reach {LOCATION}, the enemy will hold out through winter — and we are finished. {REWARD} denars. It is the only budget I have. Intercept them before they arrive. Otherwise... this region will have new masters by next year.

That convoy bound for {LOCATION} carries army grain, iron ingots, and fine medicine — worth double the market price at least. {REWARD} denars for the job, and you keep three parts in ten of everything you seize. This deal cannot lose you a coin.
You found it! A little battered, perhaps... but it is the one. {REWARD} denars — thank you. This means more to me than you know.
{TARGET} is out — it was a close call, but they're unharmed. {REWARD} denars, take them. I'll remember this.
They weren't freed... the guards had been reinforced. I don't blame you — maybe it was impossible from the very start. Keep the deposit.
The brigand den is crushed! A few small fry slipped away, but they'll never amount to anything now. {REWARD} denars — the caravan masters send their regards.
They couldn't be taken... too many of them. But at least you came back alive. Hold on to {REWARD} — we'll find another way next time.
Found it! Not as much as the map promised... but not empty-handed either. {REWARD} denars — next time a map comes my way, you're the first I'll call.
A wasted journey... maybe the map was a forgery, maybe someone beat us to it. Never mind. Keep the deposit — call it payment for your trouble.
You led the pursuers away! I'm safe. You took a few wounds for it... {REWARD} denars — worth every one. You truly saved my life.
You barely escaped... and I nearly got caught myself. That plan was too dangerous. Take {REWARD} anyway — at least we're alive.
That's the one — fine quality, fair price. {REWARD} denars. You handle matters better than I could myself.
Couldn't get it... the seller changed his mind. Ah well, it happens. {REWARD} for your trouble — you didn't go for nothing.
Two wins and one loss — but that was enough! The crowd had a grand show. {REWARD} denars — come back for the next one!
You lost... struck down in the very first bout. The crowd put the blame on the opponent's strength, not you. Take {REWARD} as appearance money anyway — such things can't be foreseen.
You defeated him — {TARGET} is no longer a threat. He got away... but without his men he can't cause any more trouble. {REWARD} denars.
He was too strong... it's not your fault. That beast would take a whole army to bring down. {REWARD} for your trouble — at least you came back alive, and that alone is no small feat.
It arrived! A bit late... but the grain is in good shape. {REWARD} denars — you made decent time.
Too late... half the grain spoiled on the road. I know it's not your fault — the roads were terrible. Take {REWARD}.
A good horse! Not the finest I've seen... but it'll do. {REWARD} denars. You have a decent eye.
This horse won't do — there's something wrong with its legs. Forget it, I'll find another later. {REWARD} for your trouble — you didn't work for nothing.
You lasted all three rounds! It got rough near the end, but the judges gave the win to you! {REWARD} denars — I'll call you for the next bout!
Knocked out... your opponent was faster than you expected. At least you weren't badly hurt. {REWARD} appearance money — I lost my bet, but you're not a fighter by trade, so no blame.
Half the supplies intercepted! You've thrown the enemy's supply line into disarray. {REWARD} denars — not a complete victory, but it'll give them a headache.
The supplies still got through... their escort was bigger than expected. {REWARD} for your trouble — the intelligence was wrong, not your fault.

{TARGET} is raiding {LOCATION} with a band of brigands! The townsfolk have pooled {REWARD} denars to hire someone to drive them off. Will you lend a hand? For every moment we wait, another household suffers!
{TARGET} has been driven off for good! The good folk of {LOCATION} can finally sleep easy. {REWARD} denars — it's all we could scrape together. You're a blessing.

{TARGET} has been taken! His family is beside themselves — the kidnappers sent an ultimatum: pay the ransom or he dies. We don't have {REWARD} denars to buy his freedom, but we have enough to hire you to bring him back.
{TARGET} is back! Unharmed! His family held him and wept all through the night. {REWARD} denars... our whole family will be in your debt for life.

{LOCATION} has run out of food — the elderly and children have eaten wild greens for three days, and people will starve if this goes on. {REWARD} denars is the last of the whole village's savings — we beg you to buy grain and save us.
The grain arrived in time! Just barely. The old and young of {LOCATION} finally have food. {REWARD} denars — you saved an entire village.

{TARGET} — he was the man I trusted most in all the world. He emptied the accounts and took half my caravan with him. {REWARD} denars — help me bring back the man and the money. This betrayal... it must come to an end.
The man is recovered, and the money with him. When {TARGET} knelt before me, I nearly softened. {REWARD} denars — thank you for settling this for me.

{TARGET}'s usury has grown to a sum I can never repay. If I don't pay today, they'll come for my land deed tomorrow. {REWARD} denars — see me through this, and I'll serve you like a beast of burden for the rest of my days.
The creditor is gone — truly gone this time. I no longer have to hide from them. {REWARD} denars... I'll remember this kindness as long as I live.

This is the sacred relic passed down the {LOCATION} family line for generations — {TARGET} stole it from the shrine. Without it, the new clan head cannot even convene the clan council. {REWARD} denars — bring it back. It is the very soul of our clan.
The relic returned to the shrine, undamaged. The elders greeted you with tears in their eyes — 'The spirit of our ancestors has finally come home.' {REWARD} denars. You are our clan's benefactor.

{TARGET} is dead. Everyone in {LOCATION} now fears for their lives — subordinates suspect each other, and outside enemies circle. A bounty of {REWARD} denars for the true culprit — will you take it? This is about more than money.
The true culprit has been brought to justice. {LOCATION} has returned to order — on the surface, at least. {REWARD} denars. You saw that justice was done, though the price was not small.
You again... it seems our accounts aren't settled yet.
Hmph. I knew we'd meet again sooner or later. Last time isn't finished.
So you came. That scar on your face still looks fresh — just like mine. Every time it aches, I remember who you are.
There will be no more running this time. You and I — only one of us leaves here alive today.
They're already telling the tale — they'll call this a fated duel. And we both know it is. Come, then.
See this scar? It aches every time it rains. And every time it aches, I think of you — and swear that next time, I'll kill you.
Remember how it ended last time? You on your knees, and I let you go. That was the greatest mistake I ever made — I won't repeat it today.
Did you think you could run forever? I've been hunting you for a long time. Every town, every tavern — someone always gives away where you've been.
*You lie on the ground as he stands over you.* 'Remember this feeling. Next time, I may not let you go.'
*He falls — at last, he falls. The feud between you comes to an end in this moment.* ...Perhaps.
*muttering* What is {PLAYER} doing here...
*muttering* {PLAYER} is up to something...
*muttering* Crouching here in broad daylight...
*raising voice* Hey! {PLAYER}! What are you crouching there for!
*sharply* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Get up! Stop crouching there!
*frowning* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! What are you crouching for?!
*glances uneasily* Why is that {ITEM} drawn...
*glances over* {PLAYER} still holding that {ITEM}...
*keeping an eye* {PLAYER} hasn't put that {ITEM} away...
*takes a step back* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Put that {ITEM} away!
*low voice* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Sheathe that {ITEM}! This is not a battlefield!
*warningly* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Put that {ITEM} away, now!
*casts a glance* What are you rummaging for...
*side-eye* Looking for something...
*puzzled* What are you rummaging through...
*staring* Hey! {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! What are you rummaging for!
*steps closer* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Hands out of there!
*glaring* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! What are you touching?!
Eh? Where's {TARGET}'s {ITEM}?
*muttering* Where did {TARGET}'s {ITEM} go...
*puzzled* What happened to that {ITEM}...
*gasps* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! You stole {ITEM}!
*roars* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Put that {ITEM} down! It belongs to {TARGET}!
*furious* Thief! {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR} stole {ITEM}!
*startled* What's going on?!
*stunned* They're fighting each other...
*taken aback* Is {PLAYER} attacking {TARGET}?!
*steps back, hand on hilt* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Stop! Keep fighting and I will draw my blade!
*grips weapon* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Stop! {TARGET} is one of us!
*warning* {SPEAKER_PLAYER_ADDR}! Push it any further and I won't hold back!
